title: Applied ML research — weekly quick capture (Oct 5 2026)
content:
Weekly quick capture: research standup + notes (raw, short-form). Goal: capture progress on small experiments that feed into the Oct rollout plan for quantized onboarding and eval harnesses.

Attendees: Maya, Arjun, Lena, Diego (plus SRE drop-in).

High-level status: 
- Quant pipeline: prototype GPTQ pipeline for 13B model (rw-13b-v1) is functional end-to-end; artifacts saved to experiments/2026-10/gptq-13b. We see ~2.6x reduction in peak GPU memory and ~1.9x throughput improvement for batch size 8 on A10G drivers with no-fp16 fallback.
- Eval harness: lightweight regression suite (subset of standard promptset) is wired into CI; failing cases tracked separately.
- Model onboarding: two candidates (rw-7b-v2, rw-13b-v1) ready for closed beta; we need to run latency SLO sims under Redwood Dedicated config.

Notes and quick results:
- GPTQ 4-bit (per-layer) on rw-13b-v1: perplexity on PTB mini-set increased by +6.7% relative to fp16 baseline; chat-quality subjective review: 3/5 degraded on long-context math. Latency: median token latency reduced from 12.4ms to 8.3ms (in our serving sim).
- NF4 (custom quant) on rw-7b-v2: perceptual quality maintained on dialogue tests; quant artifacts rare (<2% of responses show truncation issues). Memory down ~45%. Need to test with KV cache warmup (we saw occasional incorrect cache invalidation in experiment #19).
- KV-cache bug: when switching between model variants in routing test harness, the cache invalidation logic sometimes fails for quantized checkpoints (repro steps logged in linked PR). Blocker for canary rollout; SRE assigned to reproduce on dedicated cluster.
- Eval regressions: two prompt groups (code generation edge-cases, multi-turn summarization) show notable drift after quantization. Action item: expand eval set with targeted adversarial prompts by Friday.

Action items and owners:
- Arjun: finish deterministic repro for KV-cache invalidation; create minimal test case and attach to JIRA-APPLIEDML-452 (due 2026-10-07).
- Lena: run Dedicated-sim latency sweep for rw-7b-v2 and rw-13b-v1 under burst policy; collect p95/p99 and throughput numbers (due 2026-10-09).
- Diego: iterate on GPTQ hyperparams (block size, group size) to reduce PPL delta; try mixed GPTQ+NF4 for critical layers (due 2026-10-11).
- Maya: curate extended eval prompt set (add 150 targeted prompts covering summarization/code/math) and wire into CI (due 2026-10-08).

Decisions / proposals:
- Proposal: for initial canary, allow rw-7b-v2 NF4 as primary with fallback to fp16 rw-7b-v2 in case of regression. Need SLA/rollout policy defined in product console.
- Temporary policy: disable cross-variant KV reuse until cache bug confirmed fixed.

Risks and blockers:
- KV-cache invalidation bug prevents safe canary for quantized checkpoints. High priority.
- Subjective quality regression on long-context math for GPTQ 4-bit — may require selective fp16 for Transformer feedforward in math-sensitive layers.

Random notes / to-self: 
- Quick checklist for onboarding doc: sample prompt templates, eval baseline numbers, quant build instructions, how to run CI harness locally, rollback steps.
- Consider adding a lightweight human review step for first 1000 production responses after canary.

Meeting follow-ups: 
- Quick sync Tue 10/6 9:30am PT (15m) to confirm blocker status.
- Full demo Wed 10/7 4pm PT with SRE and Console PM to agree rollout policy.

References / links in convo: see linked_artifacts above. Put experimental logs in experiments/2026-10/gptq-13b and experiment-19 for KV reproducer.

End of quick capture (informal). Keep iterating — this is intentionally terse.
